description: Root package.json for the AI Chatbot monorepo. This file exists solely to coordinate the two sub-packages: 'client/' (React + Vite frontend, port 5173) and 'server/' (Express + Node.js backend, port 3001). It does not contain application source code. The 'dev' script uses 'concurrently' to start both packages in parallel with a single command. The 'install:all' script installs dependencies for both packages in sequence. Neither 'client/' nor 'server/' inherits dependencies from this root — each manages its own node_modules.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
